change.title: Establish the S1 typed Science stop contract
change.summary: Replaces the string-only Science stop boundary with a process-local typed request, optional exact ownership receipt, verified-stop outcome, and classified failure outcome. Existing mode, settings, stop/quit, history, one-click compensation and DB restart, Codex downgrade, and native-exit callers are migrated without changing lock timing, command or DTO text, stop-script/TERM/KILL/wait order, receipt cleanup, or native-exit best-effort behavior.

basis: existing Science stop characterization identity checks the closed typed failure-kind projection and the post-TERM complete, exact-KILL, and identity-drift decision matrix while preserving its exact source-gate test identity
the existing source boundary identity asserts typed request, ownership receipt, verified outcome, classified failures, exact/recover caller migration, and removal of the string-only stop helper

serial focused R0 characterization passed 53 tests with zero failures and 12 approved ignored identities; the one unrelated parallel Codex cancellation failure passed on exact rerun and the serial matrix passed cleanly

the repaired candidate received a clean-context independent review with zero BLOCK, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW findings after the initial reviewer finding on post-TERM identity-drift classification was repaired and retested
the first committed candidate completion review found that unproven idempotent stop success could still be promoted to confirmed-stopped authority
the repaired candidate derives confirmed runtime and every exact cleanup from VerifiedScienceStop ownership proof; existing Rust and source-boundary identities reject unproven promotion
a follow-up candidate review found rollback restart and history recovery still used the idempotent helper; both now acquire exact managed receipts and require matching verified stop proof

an all-caller review found observed-stopped and remembered/planned runtime branches could still publish confirmed authority; direct Some(runtime) publication is removed and branch-level boundaries freeze the rule
an authority-publish review found rollback could continue with no runtime and no receipt when the port was closed; only an existing verified-stopped receipt may now enter that restart branch

a rollback-closure review found offline history restore lacked a carried typed precondition; the in-memory session now distinguishes exact-stopped from no-managed-runtime observation and revalidates either before credential restore

a typed-quiescence review found remembered-runtime production, raw-port revalidation, and reusable-session drift gaps; production now excludes remembered runtime, reruns the full typed probe, and advances reused proof after exact stop
a complete exact-SHA 15-suite GATE-SOURCE seal and clean-context completion review are required before S1 can advance to DONE
